user.title: Set up Xbox TV
user.description:
Enter your Xbox console details. The console can be off during setup.

Console prerequisites:
- Instant-on power mode (Settings → General → Power mode & startup)
- Allow connections from any device (Settings → Devices & connections → Remote features → Xbox app preferences)

data_description.name: Friendly name for this Xbox in Home Assistant
data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Xbox on your LAN
data_description.live_id: Found in Settings → System → Console info → Xbox network device ID

auth_choice.title: Microsoft account
auth_choice.description: Sign in with Microsoft to list installed apps and games and switch sources. You can skip and add sign-in later.

oauth.title: Microsoft sign-in
oauth.description:
Open this URL in a browser, sign in, and paste the full redirect URL below:

{authorize_url}

data_description.redirect_url: The full URL from your browser after signing in (starts with http://localhost/auth/callback)

reconfigure_auth.title: Microsoft account
reconfigure_auth.description: Optionally sign in again to refresh your Microsoft tokens.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname.
error.invalid_live_id: Enter a valid Xbox network device ID (8–32 hex characters).
error.invalid_code: Could not read an authorization code from that URL. Paste the full redirect URL.

create_entry.default:
Xbox TV is ready.

**Apple Home / HomeKit:** Do not add this media player to your existing HomeKit Bridge. Apple will not show a Television on a mixed bridge.

Add a **separate** HomeKit integration entry in **accessory** mode that includes **only** this Xbox media player, then pair it in Apple Home as a new Television accessory.

microsoft_sign_in.title: Sign in with Microsoft
microsoft_sign_in.description: Sign in with Microsoft to power off the console and switch apps and games. Power on and on/off presence still work without sign-in.
